snippet.title: Quake 30th Anniversary Jam - A Community Tribute
snippet.description:
Download here: https://www.moddb.com/mods/map-centers-quake-30th-anniversary-jam
Join Map-Center for Mapping awesomeness: https://discord.gg/vSvqwys5hB

When we announced our Quake 30th Anniversary Jam I secretly hoped we would end up with 30 maps and I guess the Elder Gods listened, because that’s exactly what happened! We’ve got a brand-new hub for you, that divides 28 maps into 5 distinct Level Themes, mimicking the episode set up of the original game. Of course, it wouldn’t be complete without a new take on the original boss fight, so you get to face Shub-Niggurath from a different perspective as well. That makes 30 maps for the 30th anniversary of our beloved Quake. That’s great and all, but more importantly, we’re paying tribute to the original gameplay. Our guidelines were strict and our playtesting rigorous to ensure that this is the game you remember, just with more detail! Now, let’s celebrate Quake together!

Support the Channel: https://buymeacoffee.com/jeremiebeli
Join this channel to get access to perks:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAFWTcUY96HYHCOqf5bgNEQ/join

#quake #idsoftware #classicgames
